The '''Huvveck system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[University of Huvveck]].<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Huvveck system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
